qudag_overview: QuDAG is a quantum-resistant distributed communication platform designed for autonomous AI agents, swarm intelligence, and zero-person businesses. It provides the foundation for secure, decentralized agent communication using post-quantum cryptography.

core_components.consensus: QR-Avalanche DAG consensus with Byzantine fault tolerance
core_components.networking: LibP2P with Kademlia DHT, onion routing, NAT traversal
core_components.mcp_server: Complete MCP implementation with 6 tools, multiple transports
core_components.exchange: rUv tokens, dynamic fees, agent verification, immutable deployment

strategic_value: Provides quantum-resistant agent communication backbone, resource trading platform, and decentralized infrastructure for Neucleos zero-person businesses
